title: 第11章 不是这也太没存在感了吧第12章 你们出来的时候没看见他吗
slug: 掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟
content_zh:
“你修为最弱，待在后面吧！”
周清突然转过身对鹿瑶瑶道。
原本清冷的鹿瑶瑶顿时莞尔一笑，随后点了点头，站在了周清身后。
两个此地最弱的人，就这么看着其他七人率先踏入眼前的通道。
只是刚一进去，一股股异常磅礴浩瀚的重力感，犹如一头苏醒的巨龙般，猛地自上方压了下来。
所有人的脸顿时一红，腰一弓，立马双手撑住地面，收紧丹田，这才缓缓站了起来。
随后犹如泥牛入潭般，顶着超越平常四五倍的重力缓缓前进。
好在这次那些钻入深处的游魂并没有再出现，使得众人不由加快脚步。
周清见此，这才放下心来，跟鹿瑶瑶对视一眼后，便开始踏入其中。
刚一进去，那股重力感便轰然而来，猝不及防下的他差点摔倒，咬着牙一点点挺直腰板，随后便慢慢往前走去。
只是刚走了几十米，通道深处顿时传来呼啸声。
之前那些消失的游魂再次出现，并发出尖锐刺耳的咆哮声，就此冲了过来。
众人脸色顿时一变。
可还没等接近呢，一道道炽热的光芒猛然自众人身上散发而出。
那些游魂当即发出凄厉的惨叫，连连后退。
“有用！”
见到这一幕，大家一颗悬挂的心总算是放了下来。
而那些游魂又很快冲向最后面的鹿瑶瑶。
鹿瑶瑶身上同样绽放光芒，将其逼退。
不过，她很快就发现了不对劲。

因为所有的游魂全都攻向了她，压根没理一旁的周清。
直至游魂们觉得这些外来人都是有备而来，无法近身后，又呼啸着往深处折返回去。
在周清身上连试都没试，就像看不见一样。
万一他身上没太上长老赐予的阳火符呢？
此时周清也是一愣，很快反应过来了什么，双眼直冒精光。
是了，这群游魂普遍凝气境，但他的天赋技能【降低存在感】可是升级到了lv2，连着筑基境都有30％的概率忽略他呢。
瞬间，周清信心爆棚，但为了不引起怀疑，他还是一脸怒气喊道：“喂喂喂，你们干什么，这么大一个活人看不见吗？什么意思，看不起我吗？”
鹿瑶瑶见此，连忙道：“周师兄，小声一点，别把它们再招回来。”
走在前面的七人在听到周清愤愤的喊声后，顿时一个个面带不悦。
周清这才住嘴。
随后众人继续顶着压力一点点前行，但很快，通道深处再次传来呼啸声，更有一股冷气扑面而来。
“大家小心！”
走在最前方的一名筑基境圆满师兄立马大喊一声，其余人赶紧戒备。
紧接着，大量的游魂自前方呼啸而来。
众人顿时脸色大变，全身灵力涌动，随时准备大战。
砰砰砰！
果然，这次这些游魂竟直接不要命的冲了上来，好在众人身上的符纸再次绽放，将其短暂逼退。
吼——
随之，它们又冲了上来，有游魂在这股炽热的符文下化为飞灰，可似乎并未震慑住，它们前赴后继的冲撞着。
“这样下去不是办法，符纸的力量会被消耗殆尽的，大家加快步伐并反击！”

有人大喊，虽然顶着平日里好几倍的压力前行，动作迟缓，但他们到底是筑基境，还能怕一些凝气境的游魂？
轰轰轰！
众人拿出各自的武器直接开始了对轰，可空中传来的重力感却如沉重的枷锁，死死地压在他们的肩头。
每一次抬臂，每一次移步，
本章未完，请翻下一页继续阅读.........掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟最新章节第11章不是，这也太没存在感了吧，都需要耗费极大的力气，尤其体内灵力的滞涩更是极大限制了己身。
content_en:
"You are the weakest in cultivation, stay back!"
Zhou Qing suddenly turned around and said to Lu Yaoyao.
Lu Yaoyao, who was originally cold, suddenly smiled, then nodded and stood behind Zhou Qing.
The two weakest people here just watched the other seven people take the lead in stepping into the passage in front of them.
But as soon as he entered, an unusually majestic and vast sense of gravity suddenly pressed down from above, like an awakening dragon.
Everyone's faces suddenly turned red, their waists bowed, and they immediately put their hands on the ground, tightened their Dantian, and then slowly stood up.
Then, like a mud cow entering a pool, it slowly advanced against a gravity that was four or five times greater than normal.
Fortunately, the wandering souls that had burrowed into the depths did not appear again this time, causing everyone to speed up their pace.
Seeing this, Zhou Qing felt relieved. After looking at each other with Lu Yaoyao, he started to step inside.
As soon as he entered, the feeling of gravity came over him. He was caught off guard and almost fell down. He gritted his teeth and straightened his back little by little, and then slowly walked forward.
Just after walking a few dozen meters, a whistling sound suddenly came from deep in the passage.
The wandering souls that disappeared before reappeared and rushed over with a sharp and ear-piercing roar.
Everyone's expressions suddenly changed.
But before they could get close, blazing rays of light suddenly emanated from everyone.
Those wandering souls immediately let out shrill screams and retreated continuously.
"It works!"
Seeing this scene, everyone finally felt relieved.
And those wandering souls quickly rushed towards Lu Yaoyao who was at the back.
Lu Yaoyao's body also glowed with light, forcing her back.
However, she soon realized something was wrong.
Because all the wandering souls attacked her, they didn't pay attention to Zhou Qing who was standing aside.
Until the wandering souls felt that these outsiders had come prepared and were unable to get close, they whizzed back into the depths.
He didn't even try it on Zhou Qing, it was like he couldn't see it.
What if he doesn't have the Yang Fire Talisman given by the Supreme Elder?
At this time, Zhou Qing was also stunned. He quickly realized something and his eyes gleamed.
Yes, these wandering souls are generally in the Qi Condensation Realm, but his innate skill [Reduce Presence] has been upgraded to lv2, and there is a 30% probability of ignoring him even in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
In an instant, Zhou Qing was full of confidence, but in order not to arouse suspicion, he still shouted angrily: "Hey, hey, hey, what are you doing? Can such a big living person not see you? What do you mean, you look down on me?"
Seeing this, Lu Yaoyao hurriedly said: "Senior Brother Zhou, keep your voice down, don't recruit them back again."
The seven people walking in front suddenly looked unhappy after hearing Zhou Qing's angry shouts.
Only then did Zhou Qing shut up.
Then everyone continued to move forward little by little despite the pressure, but soon, there was another whistling sound from deep in the passage, and there was even a blast of cold air.
"Everyone, be careful!"
A senior brother who was at the forefront of the Foundation Establishment Realm immediately shouted, and the others hurriedly took precautions.
Immediately afterwards, a large number of wandering souls roared from the front.
Everyone's expressions suddenly changed, and their spiritual power surged throughout their bodies, ready for a fight at any time.
Bang bang bang!
Sure enough, this time these wandering souls rushed forward desperately. Fortunately, the talismans on everyone's body bloomed again, forcing them back briefly.
Roar——
Then, they rushed up again, and some wandering souls were turned into ashes under the blazing runes, but they didn't seem to be frightened, and they rushed forward one after another.
"This is not the way to go. The power of the talisman will be exhausted. Everyone, speed up the pace and fight back!"
Someone shouted that although they were moving slowly despite being under pressure several times normal, they were still in the Foundation Establishment Realm. How could they still be afraid of wandering souls in the Qi Condensation Realm?
Boom boom boom!
Everyone took out their own weapons and started fighting directly, but the feeling of gravity coming from the air was like a heavy shackle, pressing firmly on their shoulders.
